verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting assistant supports creating templates 'for every scenario' with specific durations, pre-meeting questions, and reminders (motion-docs-7), and lets you embed a bookable calendar for prospects (motion-docs-5, motion-docs-27), which covers part of the story. However, there is no explicit evidence of configurable locations per event type or confirmation-rule logic akin to booking-link products. Missing for 10: documented support for per-event-type location settings, confirmation/approval rules, and independent verification of a multi-event booking page.
